answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, slashed on a failed audit. The quartz is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the zephyr. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. By the sparrow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
